conversation_transcript.content: Hi there! Thanks for calling TechFlow. I'm Alex — how can I help you today?

Hey Alex! I'm Sarah. I've been looking at workflow tools because honestly, our current platform is painfully slow. Like, dashboards take 30 seconds to load. I heard TechFlow might be better — can you walk me through what you guys do?

Absolutely, Sarah. I'm sorry to hear about the speed issues — that's a productivity killer. Let me hit the top three things that set TechFlow apart. First, our real-time analytics dashboard loads in under 2 seconds, even with large datasets. Second, we have native integrations with Salesforce and HubSpot, so you're not dealing with clunky third-party connectors. And third, everything runs on SOC 2 Type II certified infrastructure with a 99.9% uptime SLA. Would any of those be particularly relevant to your use case?
Oh wow, the dashboard speed thing is huge for us. And we actually use HubSpot, so that native integration is really appealing. What does pricing look like?

Great — you'd get a lot of value from the HubSpot integration right away. For pricing, we have three tiers: Starter at $29 per seat per month, Professional at $79 which includes the advanced analytics and integrations, and Enterprise at $149 with dedicated support and custom SLAs. Based on what you've described, Professional would likely be the sweet spot — you'd get the fast dashboards and HubSpot integration. How many seats are you looking at?
Probably around 15-20. That Professional tier sounds right. How long does onboarding usually take? We're hoping to switch before Q3.

For a team of 15-20 on Professional, onboarding typically takes 2-3 weeks. We assign a dedicated onboarding specialist who handles data migration, sets up your HubSpot connection, and trains your team. You'd easily be up and running before Q3. Want me to set up a guided demo so you can see the dashboard speed firsthand?
That sounds really good actually. I need to run this by my director first, but yeah, let's set up that demo. Can you send me some pricing details I can forward to her?
Of course! I'll send a pricing summary and a link to book a demo directly to your email. What's the best address to reach you at?

sarah.chen@novacommerce.com. Thanks Alex, this was really helpful. I'll be in touch after I talk to my team.

[GOAL_ACHIEVED]

1.recommendations:
Consider proactively mentioning a free trial option to lower the commitment barrier.
Ask about specific pain points earlier to personalize the pitch more deeply.
